title: Plus Upgrade Autopay Credit — Rental Property Service Contracts
content:
A Rental Property Service Contracts Plus upgrade charge carries an autopay credit read from the contract's payment history.

| Most recent premium payment posted on the contract | Returned payment billed back on the contract in the 12 months before the upgrade | Autopay credit |
|---|---|---|
| made by ACH | none | 0.03 |
| made by ACH | one or more | 0.01 |
| made another way | any | 0 |

**Records read.** The payment method of the latest premium payment in the contract's billing history; the returned payment charges and their dates.

**How the credit acts.** Credits on a Plus upgrade charge are subtracted from one and a loading is added to it, all in one sum, and the charge is multiplied once by that sum before its single rounding to the cent.

*Hypothetical:* last payment by check: 0, whatever the return history. Last payment by ACH with no return in the 12 months: 0.03.
